pages.text: Some apparent ore deposits are living ambush predators. An Ore Mimic remains motionless against stone until it notices prey, then unfolds into a two-block humanoid shape.$(br2)Movement is the surest confirmation. Once active, it should be treated as a hostile creature rather than a block.
Its disguise is meant to exploit the expectation that ore is harmless. I should approach exposed deposits with enough space to retreat, particularly where a shape or placement seems unnatural.
